content.title: Jack Osbourne's 5 Kids: All About His Daughters (Including His New Baby!)
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Jack Osbourne shares three kids with ex-wife Lisa Stelly: daughters Pearl, Minnie and AndyHe welcomed daughter Maple with wife Aree Gearhart in July 2022Osbourne and Gearhart welcomed ther second baby together, another girl, in March 2026 Jack Osbourne is now a dad of five. In December 2025, Osbourne and his wife, Aree Gearhart, announced that they are expecting their second baby together and announced her arrival in March 2026, revealing that they had named her Ozzy Matilda Osbourne after his late father. Osbourne shares three children — Pearl, Andy and Minnie — with his ex-wife, Lisa Stelly. In 2013, Stelly was also pregnant with the couple's baby boy, Theo, though she had a late-term miscarriage in her second trimester. After Osbourne and Stelly finalized their divorce in 2019, Osbourne started dating his now-wife, Gearhart. Osbourne and Gearhart got engaged in December 2021 and welcomed their first baby, Maple, the following July, with daughter Ozzy arriving less than five years later. In a 2018 interview with PEOPLE, Osbourne touched on co-parenting with his ex-wife, saying he and Stelly were “doing really well” with it. “It’s all you can really ask for at this stage. It’s great," he said. Osbourne also spoke about how his parenting style differs from that of his parents, Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne. “I’m a little more structured with my kids than my parents were with me,” he explained. “I won’t take them out of school just to go travel. We do a little bit, but I think structure is healthy.” Here’s everything to know about Jack Osbourne’s daughters. Pearl Clementine Osbourne, 13 Sharon Osbourne and Pearl Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram Osbourne's oldest daughter, Pearl Clementine Osbourne, was born on April 24, 2012. When she arrived, her grandmother, Sharon, wrote on X, “Today I witnessed my first grandchild being born, life changing experience. She is an angel.” Pearl was born only three weeks after Osbourne was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis (MS). “There’s this weird association with my life before [being a] parent and then my life before MS,” he told PEOPLE in 2016. Osbourne also talked about how Pearl was already “pushing the limits” at just 4 ½-years-old. “She’s understanding what defiance is, and if she digs her heels in she might actually get her way and what she wants to do versus [listening] to her mother and [me],” he said. Pearl made a few cameos on her father and grandfather's History Channel series, Ozzy & Jack’s World Detour, when she was younger. One appearance happened in the episode “Pearls of Wisdom,” when the father and son took Pearl on a camping trip. Aree Gearhart, Jack Osbourne and Pearl Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram In a 2016 interview with PEOPLE, Osbourne opened up about Pearl’s love of nature, saying, “She loves the outdoors, so she takes after me a little bit. I take her camping as much as I can and take her outdoors.” He also said that Pearl loves “being scared” and is a big fan of Halloween. Osbourne explained she had recently discovered Nightmare Before Christmas and loved talking about and watching Jack Skellington and Mr. Oogie Boogie. It also seems like Pearl is a loving older sister. In a 2017 interview with PEOPLE, Stelly said, “Pearl’s the greatest big sister ever. She’s so sweet.” Pearl appears to love spending time with her family, as her mom and dad are frequently posting photos of her with them and other family members on social media. In 2023, Osbourne shared a since-deleted photo of Pearl and her grandma hugging, and way back in 2013, he posted one of Pearl making her grandpa laugh. Andy Rose Osbourne, 10 Jack Osbourne and Andy Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram Osbourne's second daughter with Stelly, Andy Rose Osbourne, was born on June 13, 2015. Osbourne has called Andy “a very unique individual,” saying she gave him a bit of a tough time when she was a toddler. During a 2021 interview on the Tamron Hall Show, Osbourne talked about what made her different, saying that when she was nearly 3 years old, she decided she “just didn’t want to wear clothes anymore.” “So it started with no shoes and then no socks, and then no pants or skirts or dresses, and then no T-shirt and then she decided that diapers were fire,” he said. Andy Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram Related Stories However, she quickly grew out of that phase. In a 2018 interview with PEOPLE, Osbourne said that Andy would only wear big gowns all day long. “Like she’s going to a quinceanera every day,” he joked. Osbourne also said his daughters are “the most girly girls imaginable” and that he’s always surrounded by unicorns and rainbows. In 2023, Andy started third grade. Osbourne shared photos of her first day of school on Instagram, writing, "First Day of School! Maple with the big send off for Andy & Minnie." Minnie Theodora Osbourne, 8 Minnie Osbourne. Lisa Stelly Instagram Osbourne and Stelly’s daughter, Minnie Theodora Osbourne, was born on Feb. 3, 2018. Osbourne announced her birth with a photo on Instagram, writing, “She’s the newest member of my girl squad,” in the caption. On Minnie’s first birthday, Osbourne shared a sweet photo of her eating cake, accompanied by a sentimental message. “My little ray of light turned one on Sunday,” he wrote on Instagram. “She’s such a blessing and it [has] been so much fun getting to know her over the last year. She’s sweet and playful and loves her big sisters so much." Kelly Osbourne and Minnie Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram Osbourne continued, "I can’t wait to see what magic will come from her as she circles the sun for another time. Minnie I love you with all my heart.” Now, Minnie seemingly has a close relationship with her aunt Kelly Osbourne. In June 2023, Osbourne shared a sweet snap of his daughter enjoying a playdate with his sister, Kelly. In the photo, Minnie sat on Kelly's lap as someone applied pink eyeshadow onto her eyelids. “Minnie having a play date with Auntie,” Jack captioned the post. Maple Artemis Osbourne, 3 Jack Osbourne and Maple Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram Osbourne's fourth daughter — and first with now-wife Gearhart — Maple Artemis Osbourne was born on July 9, 2022. She arrived only a few months after Osbourne and Gearhart got engaged. He announced that Gearhart was pregnant with a sweet photo of himself resting his hand on Gearhart’s belly. He posted the photo on Instagram with the caption, “Exciting news!!! @seecreature and I are expecting a baby in the summer! Baby #4 here we come!” The couple made the announcement on Gearhart’s birthday, and in her own Instagram post, she wrote, “Today is my birthday, but my gift doesn’t arrive till summer ;-) new member of our tribe coming summer 2022.” After Maple was born, the new parents shared the happy news on their social media pages. Osbourne posted a now-deleted picture of Maple in a fuzzy bodysuit with bear ears and wrote, “Aree and Maple are doing great and are happy and healthy.” Aree Gearhart, Jack Osbourne and Maple Osbourne. Jack Osbourne Instagram While she is still just a baby, she has an unmistakable resemblance to Osbourne. In a now-deleted photo, the proud dad shared on Instagram, the two looked almost identical while making the same face. Just two months after Maple's first birthday, her parents tied the knot. The couple revealed on Instagram in September 2023 that they had "snuck away" to say "I do." "Something really cool happened," Osbourne captioned a photo from their wedding day. "I married the most amazing women I’ve ever met. All in." Ozzy Matilda Osbourne Ozzy Matilda Osbourne. Jack Osbourne/Instagram Osbourne and Gearhart shared the news that they were expecting their second baby together — Jack's fifth — in a December 2025 interview with The Sun on Sunday. At the time of their announcement, Gearhart was 28 weeks pregnant, which means that the couple was able to tell Ozzy the news of their baby-to-be before he died in July. "I think it’s been partly a healthy distraction, partly healing — probably in that kind of ‘full cycle’ category, in a weird way," Osbourne said. "It’s very much taken energy out of the grieving side of things and parked in a bit more hopefulness." They also shared the first photo of Gearhart's baby bump in a joint post on Instagram, as she wrote, "oops i did it again!" In March 2026, the couple announced that their baby had arrived on March 5 in a joint Instagram post, revealing that they named her Ozzy Matilda Osbourne.
